text:
maya: FYI I noticed a spike in project-admin grants during the org-onboarding job this morning. Several new users ended up with project:* perms for a few orgs.

raj: wtf. which orgs? can you repro?

maya: org ids: org-842, org-991, org-117. repro steps look like the migration script applied `role_map` before scope-sanitizer ran. snippet from the job log: 
```
2025-03-12T07:02:11Z INFO applying role_map for org-842 user=jane.doe@example.com -> role=project-admin
2025-03-12T07:02:11Z DEBUG scope-sanitizer skipped for org-842 reason=missing-flag
```

sasha: that matches what I saw in the rollout changelog. commit c3f9b2b added the new role_map ordering. I flagged it in the PR but didn't realize the flag gating was off in prod.

evan: urgent steps: 1) pause the org-onboarding job 2) run a targeted revert for the role_map ordering 3) enumerate and remove the unintended project-admin grants 4) rotate service principals affected by the grant window (KMS keys may need rewrap).

infra-bot: paused job org_onboard_v2 (run_id=6674) at 2051240000. background tasks draining.

maya: where are the audit logs for the grant events? need the who/when.

audit-bot: grant events are indexed to s3://redwood-audit/2025/03/12/ and in ES index audit-2025-03. quick query: `GET /audit-2025-03/_search?q=event:grant AND actor.role:service_account AND time:[2025-03-12T07:00:00Z TO 2025-03-12T07:10:00Z]` returns 42 hits.

raj: can we scope list affected principals quickly? i'll run `rbacctl` and make a CSV.

raj: running: `rbacctl list --filter 'granted_by:org_onboard_v2' --fields user,org,roles --format csv > /tmp/onboard-grants.csv` (will share).

sasha: mitigation note: for org-842 and org-991, we should remove project-admin and replace with project-viewer until we validate. do not delete users.

evan: agree. also rotate the service principal `svc-onboard` keys in KMS and increment binding TTLs. we should assume any token used during the 7:02-07:08 window is compromised.

oncall: paging infra & sec oncall (pagerduty): sec-oncall paged.

oncall: creating incident SEC-2025-03-12-01 in PagerDuty/Statuspage and JIRA SEC-4873. adding timeline and initial findings.

maya: i've started the JIRA with the CSV attached. adding owners: @raj @evan @sasha.

raj: cleaned CSV and removed dup rows. running remediation script now: 
```
for row in $(cat /tmp/onboard-grants.csv); do 
  user=$(echo $row | cut -d, -f1)
  org=$(echo $row | cut -d, -f2)
  rbacctl revoke --user "$user" --org "$org" --role project-admin || echo "failed $user"
done
```

maya: please also capture `kms:Decrypt` logs for svc-onboard principal. audit-bot can correlate unwrapps.

audit-bot: pulled KMS logs for svc-onboard: s3://redwood-kms-logs/2025/03/12/svc-onboard-decrypts.json (7 entries between 07:01 and 07:09).

evan: after revoke & key rotation, we need a postmortem: root cause = role_map ordering + missing feature-flag in prod. remediation: revert ordering, add integration test for role->scope ordering, gate job with flag, add alert on surge of project-admin grants.

maya: agree. assign action items in the JIRA. i'll own the test + deploy for revert. raj to run remediation script and verify, sasha to handle KMS rotations, evan to prepare postmortem draft.

sasha: quick note — we'll need to publish an audit summary to legal/compliance. i'll prepare a redacted list of affected users and orgs.

maya: thanks all. update the incident ticket when done. :thumbsup:
